_note: Which generateContent node a Gemini model uses without a catalog pin. Only one question decides it: 2.5 takes a token `thinkingBudget` and 400s on `thinkingLevel`; 3.x takes the level.

rules.why: the 2.5 line specifically - it is the only one that takes thinkingBudget. 2.0 and earlier have no thinking control at all, so they fall to the default like everything else and simply never emit one

_default: 3.x and anything newer take thinkingLevel. An unknown id is treated as newer, which is also the shape the current generation uses.
